```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set working directory to the project root where data/ exists
# The .qmd file is in R/ subdirectory, so we need to go up one level
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath('..'))

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(tinytex)
```

```{r load-data}
# Read data from the project root's data directory
club_master <- readRDS("data/club_master.rds")
members_year <- readRDS("data/members_year.rds")
club_performance <- readRDS("data/club_performance.rds")
club_perf_year4 <- readRDS("data/club_perf_year4.rds")
rf_importance <- readRDS("data/rf_importance.rds")
```

# Report
# Title: Market Intelligence
# Subtitle: Club characteristics and Market Factors Driving Profitability



```{r custom-theme}
# Custom color palette (including chocolate3)
custom_palette <- c(
  "chocolate3",    # Your requested color
  "#E69F00",       # Orange
  "#56B4E9",       # Sky Blue
  "#009E73",       # Teal
  "#F0E442"        # Yellow
)

# Define a reusable theme
fit_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, color = "gray30"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30", family = "Helvetica"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, color = "gray30"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## Histograms - Active Members, Revenue Per SqFt, EBITDA Per SqFt

*Chart: Distribution of Active Members, EBITDA and Revenue*

*Text: The average mature club has 8,000 active members, with revenue close to $100 (per sqft) and profit of $40 (per sqft).*

```{r histograms, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Prepare Data
perf_metrics <- club_perf_year4 %>%
  select(RevenuePerSqFt, EBITDAPerSqFt, ActiveMembers) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "PerformanceMetric", values_to = "Value")

# Calculate median values for each PerformanceMetric
median_values <- perf_metrics %>%
  group_by(PerformanceMetric) %>%
  summarise(Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot with vertical faceting and custom colors
ggplot(perf_metrics, aes(x = Value, fill = PerformanceMetric)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10, alpha = 0.7, position = "dodge") +
  geom_vline(
    data = median_values,
    aes(xintercept = Median),
    linetype = "dotted",
    color = "indianred4",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette) +  # Apply custom palette
  facet_wrap(~ PerformanceMetric, scales = "free_x") +  # Vertical faceting
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Performance Metrics",
    subtitle = "Mature Clubs. Vertical dotted lines indicate median values",
    x = "",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  fit_theme()
```

## Scatter Plot: Revenue Per SqFt vs EBITDA Per SqFt

*Chart: Relationship between Revenue and Profitability*

*Text: Not surprisingly higher revenue leads to higher profits; there are three clubs that stand out: Catonsville, Penn Station and Golden Ring.*

```{r scatter-revenue-eft, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Scatterplot of RevenuePerSqFt vs. EBITDAPerSqFt with fitted line
ggplot(club_perf_year4, aes(x = RevenuePerSqFt, y = EBITDAPerSqFt)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = EBITDAPerSqFt > 80),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = custom_palette[1], "TRUE" = custom_palette[4]),
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = club_perf_year4 %>% filter(EBITDAPerSqFt > 80),
    aes(x = RevenuePerSqFt, y = EBITDAPerSqFt, label = ClubName),
    hjust = 1.2,
    vjust = 0,
    color = custom_palette[4],
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = club_perf_year4 %>% filter(RevenuePerSqFt < 40),
    aes(x = RevenuePerSqFt, y = EBITDAPerSqFt, label = ClubName),
    hjust = 0.1,
    vjust = -1,
    color = custom_palette[1],
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,  # Horizontal line at EBITDAPerSqFt == 0
    color = custom_palette[2],
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",  # Linear regression
    se = FALSE,
    color = custom_palette[3],
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-20, 140, by = 20)) +
  labs(
    title = "Revenue vs. Profitability",
    subtitle = "Clubs with EBITDA Per SqFt > 80 are highlighted",
    x = "Revenue Per SqFt ($)",
    y = "EBITDA Per SqFt ($)"
  ) +
  fit_theme() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )
```

## Scatter Plot: Club Size vs Revenue Per SqFt

*Chart: Relationship between Club Size and Revenue (per sqft)*

*Text: The most profitable clubs tend to be smaller in size.*

```{r scatter-size-revenue, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Scatterplot of RevenuePerSqFt vs. Size
ggplot(filter(club_perf_year4, RevenuePerSqFt > 40),
       aes(x = Size, y = RevenuePerSqFt, color = EBITDAPerSqFtCat)) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Profitability",
    values = c("Low" = custom_palette[1], "Medium" = custom_palette[2], "High" = custom_palette[3])
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    color = custom_palette[2],
    linetype = "solid",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = club_perf_year4 %>% filter(ClubNumber %in% c(105, 108, 109)),
    aes(x = Size, y = RevenuePerSqFt, label = paste0(ClubName," - ", PopDensityType)),
    hjust = 0.1,
    vjust = -1,
    color = custom_palette[3],
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    color = custom_palette[3],
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(10000, 34000, by = 2500)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-10, 200)) +
  labs(
    title = "Are Bigger Clubs More Profitable?",
    subtitle = "Excludes 309 - North Miami Beach",
    x = "Club Size",
    y = "Revenue Per SqFt ($)"
  ) +
  fit_theme() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )
```

## Boxplot: EBITDA PER SQFT, Mature Clubs (Year 4)

*Chart: Segmenting Mature Clubs by Profitability*

*Text: We can group the clubs according to profitability using percentiles: 25% and 75%. The three groups correspond to Low, Medium and High profit clubs.*

```{r boxplot-ebitda, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
# Calculate median EBITDAPerSqFt for each category
median_ebitda <- club_perf_year4 %>%
  group_by(EBITDAPerSqFtCat) %>%
  summarise(MedianEBITDAPerSqFt = median(EBITDAPerSqFt, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n()
            ) %>%
  ungroup()

# EBITDA Per SqFt
ggplot(club_perf_year4, aes(x = EBITDAPerSqFt, y = EBITDAPerSqFtCat, fill = EBITDAPerSqFtCat)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(height = 0.1), alpha = 0.5, color = "gray52") +
  # Annotate median values below the boxplots
  geom_text(
    data = median_ebitda,
    aes(
      x = MedianEBITDAPerSqFt,
      y = EBITDAPerSqFtCat,
      label = paste0("$", round(MedianEBITDAPerSqFt, 0))
    ),
    vjust = -5.4,
    hjust = 0.5,
    color = "gray30",
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = median_ebitda,
    aes(
      x = 120,
      y = EBITDAPerSqFtCat,
      label = paste0("n = ", n)
    ),
    color = "grey60",
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Segmentation by Profitability - Mature Clubs",
    subtitle = "Values shown for the Average Club",
    x = "EBITDA Per SqFt",
    y = "Category"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = c("Low", "Medium", "High")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0("$", round(x, 1))) +
  fit_theme()
```

*Clubs with EBITDA close to zero*
* 301 - Coconut Creek, FL*
* 303 - Pompano, FL*
* 309 - North Miami Beach, FL*
* 128 - Penn Branch, DC*

## Performance Metrics: Growth % Years 0-4, Mature Clubs (Year 4)

*Chart: Segmenting Mature Clubs by Growth %*

*Text: Clubs are also grouped by Growth % using the same percentiles: 25% and 75%.*

```{r boxplot-growth, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
# Calculate median Growth % 04 for each category
median_cagryears04 <- club_perf_year4 %>%
  filter(!is.na(CAGRYears04)) %>%
  group_by(CAGRYears04Cat) %>%
  summarise(MedianCAGRYears04 = median(CAGRYears04, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n()
            ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Subset to records where CAGRYears47 is not NULL and exclude 309 - Miami Beach (low revenue)
plot_data <- club_perf_year4 %>%
  filter(!is.na(CAGRYears04))

# Growth % (Years 0-4)
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = CAGRYears04, y = CAGRYears04Cat, fill = CAGRYears04Cat)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(height = 0.1), 
             alpha = 0.5, 
             color = "gray52") +
  # Annotate median values below the boxplots
  geom_text(
    data = median_cagryears04,
    aes(
      x = MedianCAGRYears04,
      y = CAGRYears04Cat,
      label = paste0(round(MedianCAGRYears04*100, 0), "%")
    ),
    vjust = -5.4,
    hjust = 0.5,
    color = "gray30",
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = median_cagryears04,
    aes(
      x = .22,
      y = CAGRYears04Cat,
      label = paste0("n = ", n)
    ),
    color = "grey60",
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Segmentation by Growth % - Mature Clubs",
    subtitle = ("Growth % shown for the Average Club in each Category"),
    x = "Growth % (Years 0-4)",
    y = "Category"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = c("Low", "Medium", "High")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x*100, 0), "%")) +
  fit_theme()
```

## Matrix: Growth % (Years 0-4) vs EBITDA PER SQFT

*Chart: Matrix of clubs along Profitability and Growth %*

*Text: Only two clubs hit the sweet spot of high growth and high profitability*

```{r matrix-growth-profit, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Subset to records where CAGRYears47 is not NULL and exclude 309 - Miami Beach (low revenue)
plot_data <- club_perf_year4 %>%
  filter(!is.na(CAGRYears04) & RevenuePerSqFt > 40)

# Calculate 75 percentiles
perc75_cagr <- plot_data %>%
  filter(CAGRYears04Cat == "High") %>%
  summarise(
    min_cagr = min(CAGRYears04, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pull(min_cagr)

perc75_ebitda <- plot_data %>%
  filter(EBITDAPerSqFtCat == "High") %>%
  summarise(
    min_ebitda = min(EBITDAPerSqFt, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pull(min_ebitda)

# Create Plot
ggplot(plot_data %>% filter(EBITDAPerSqFt < perc75_ebitda | CAGRYears04 < perc75_cagr),
       aes(x = CAGRYears04, y = EBITDAPerSqFt, label = ClubNumber)) +
  geom_point(color = custom_palette[1], 
             alpha = 0.7, 
             size = 4) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.8, 
            size = 4, 
            color = custom_palette[2]
            ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = perc75_ebitda, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = custom_palette[3]
             ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = perc75_cagr, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = custom_palette[3]
             ) +
  annotate("text", x = perc75_cagr, y = 100,
           label = "-> High Growth",
           hjust = -0.2,
           vjust = 0,
           color = custom_palette[3],
           size = 3.5,
           fontface = "bold"
           ) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.05, y = perc75_ebitda, na.rm = TRUE,
           label = "^ High Profitability",
           hjust = 0.2,
           vjust = -1.2,
           color = custom_palette[3],
           size = 3.5,
           fontface = "bold") +
  geom_point(data = plot_data %>% filter(EBITDAPerSqFt >= perc75_ebitda & CAGRYears04 >= perc75_cagr),
             aes(x = CAGRYears04, y = EBITDAPerSqFt),
             color = custom_palette[1], 
             alpha = 0.7, 
             size = 4) +
  geom_text(
          data = plot_data %>% filter(EBITDAPerSqFt >= perc75_ebitda & CAGRYears04 >= perc75_cagr),
          aes(x = CAGRYears04, y = EBITDAPerSqFt, label = ClubName),
          vjust = -0.8,
          size = 4,
          color = custom_palette[2]
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(-0.07, 0.26)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-10, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Growth % vs Profitabilty Matrix",
    subtitle = "Mature Clubs",
    x = "Growth % (Years 0-4)",
    y = "EBITDA Per SqFt ($)"
  ) +
  fit_theme()
```

## EBITDA PER SQFT and Growth %: Top Clubs

*Chart: List of Top Clubs according to Profitability and Growth %*

*Text: High-profit clubs have EBITDA (per sqft) above $50. In the case of Growth %, top clubs have double-digit growth rates (Years 0-4) of active members.*

```{r top-clubs, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
med_cagr <- plot_data %>%
  summarise(
    med_cagr = mean(CAGRYears04, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pull(med_cagr)

med_ebitda <- plot_data %>%
  summarise(
    med_ebitda = median(EBITDAPerSqFt, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pull(med_ebitda)

# --- Chart 1: EBITDA per SqFt ---
ebitda_persqt_sorted <- club_perf_year4 %>%
  filter(!is.na(CAGRYears04) & RevenuePerSqFt > 40) %>%
  filter(EBITDAPerSqFtCat == "High") %>%
  arrange(EBITDAPerSqFt)

p1 <- ggplot(ebitda_persqt_sorted, aes(x = EBITDAPerSqFt, 
                                       y = reorder(ClubName, EBITDAPerSqFt))
             ) +
  geom_point(size = 4, 
             alpha = 0.8, 
             color = custom_palette[1]) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, 
                   xend = EBITDAPerSqFt, 
                   yend = reorder(ClubName, EBITDAPerSqFt)
                   ),
               color = custom_palette[1], 
               alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0("$", round(x, 1)), 
                     limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_ebitda, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = custom_palette[3], 
             linewidth = 0.8
             ) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = med_ebitda, 
           y = Inf, 
           na.rm = TRUE,
           label = paste0("Avg Club: $", med_ebitda),
           hjust = -0.06, 
           vjust = 1.2, 
           color = custom_palette[3], 
           size = 3.5, 
           fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "High Profitability Clubs",
    subtitle = "Mature Clubs - Y4",
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  fit_theme() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )

# --- Chart 2: CAGR Years 4-7 ---
cagr_year4_sorted <- club_perf_year4 %>%
  filter(!is.na(CAGRYears04) & RevenuePerSqFt > 40) %>%
  filter(CAGRYears04Cat == "High") %>%
  arrange(CAGRYears04PercRank)

p2 <- ggplot(cagr_year4_sorted, 
             aes(x = CAGRYears04, 
                 y = reorder(ClubName, CAGRYears04))
             ) +
  geom_point(size = 4, 
             alpha = 0.8, 
             color = custom_palette[2]
             ) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, 
                   xend = CAGRYears04, 
                   yend = reorder(ClubName, CAGRYears04)
                   ),
               color = custom_palette[2], 
               alpha = 0.45) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, 
                     limits = c(0, 0.25)
                     ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_cagr, 
             linetype = "dashed", 
             color = custom_palette[3], 
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = med_cagr, y = Inf, 
           label = paste0("Avg Club: ", scales::percent(med_cagr, accuracy = 0.01)),
           hjust = -0.06, vjust = 1.2, 
           color = custom_palette[3], 
           size = 3.5, 
           fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "High Growth % Clubs",
    subtitle = "Years 0-4",
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  fit_theme() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )

# --- Combine plots vertically ---
p1 + plot_spacer() + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 0.1, 1))
```

## Feature Importance After Running Statistical Model

*Chart: What are the most important factors driving profitability?*

*Text: Size, female population and RentPSF are the top three factors.*

```{r feature-importance, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
# Chart: Sucess Factors Behind Profitability
# Create the plot
ggplot(rf_importance, aes(x = Importance, y = Variable, fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#0077bb",
    high = "#ee7733",
    name = "Importance Score"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = comma,
    name = "Importance Score"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest Feature Importance",
    subtitle = "Top 20 Features by Mean Decrease in Gini",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
